name: 31605 · Valdosta, GA
findings: ZIP 31605 (Valdosta) has 51 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 31605 (Valdosta) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 31605 (Valdosta) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 35% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
